content: {"praised":["Deep exploration of depression and existential themes.","Stunning visuals and atmospheric cinematography.","Strong character development, especially Kirsten Dunst's performance.","Thoughtful music score complements mood.","Unique take on apocalyptic genre."],"criticized":["Story feels incoherent and nonsensical.","Pacing is slow and tedious.","Lack of clear plot or resolution.","Dialogue hard to hear or understand.","Overemphasis on art over story."]}
